analysis.summary: Management reported a strong performance for FY26, with consolidated revenues crossing INR17,000 crores and standalone profit exceeding INR3,100 crores. Iron ore production scaled significantly to 22 million tons, and the first pellet plant achieved full capacity utilization within four months of commissioning. The company highlighted ongoing major capex, structural cost efficiencies, and strategic international expansion into copper and cobalt assets in Congo. For FY27, management provided production guidance for iron ore, pellets, DRI, and steelmaking. Lloyds Metals and Energy Limited reported highest ever quarterly and yearly revenues, EBITDA, and PAT on a standalone basis for Q4 and FY26, driven by higher iron ore EC limits, ramp-up of the pellet plant, and improved sponge iron volumes.

guidance.claim: The company guided for iron ore production of 26 million tons and dispatches of 27 million tons for FY27.
guidance.quote: Our FY '27 guidance reflects the next change in our scale, iron ore production at 26 million tons, dispatches of 27 million tons, pellet of 7.75 million to 8 million tons, DRI at 825,000 tons and a formal entry into steelmaking with wire rod mill production at around 150,000 tons.

guidance.claim: Thriveni's Odisha operation volumes are expected to increase by 39% year-to-year to 34 million tons to 35 million tons in FY27.
guidance.quote: Overall, the Odisha operation volumes are expected to increase by 39% year-to-year to 34 million tons to 35 million tons in FY27.

guidance.claim: The company expects Odisha operations volumes to increase by 39 percent YoY to 34 to 35 million tonnes in FY27.
guidance.quote: Odisha operations in volumes to increase by 39% YoY to 34-35mnt in FY27

guidance.claim: Dalpahar mines have a FY27 production target of 3 MTPA.
guidance.quote: Dalpahar Mines: Operations expected Q1 FY27; FY27 production target 3 MTPA.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that steel markets and iron ore are as strong as ever, especially in the Indian market.
demand_outlook.quote: The steel markets and therefore, iron ore are as strong as ever, especially in Indian market.

demand_outlook.claim: Robust domestic demand for iron ore and pellets supported volume growth across segments.
demand_outlook.quote: Robust domestic demand for iron ore and pellets supported volume growth across segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that India's steel industry maintained a steady growth trajectory in FY 2025-26 supported by infrastructure demand and ongoing capacity additions.
demand_outlook.quote: India’s steel industry maintained a steady growth trajectory in FY 2025-26, supported by infrastructure demand and ongoing capacity additions.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has invested INR13,500 crores in capex over the last 4 years.
capex_expansion.quote: Konsari, in Gadchiroli, we have completed the 2 pellet plants reaching capacity of 8 million tons, making us the largest merchant pellet player by far.

capex_expansion.claim: The second pellet plant was commissioned in May 2026, taking total pellet capacity to 8 million tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: I'm also pleased to share that the second pellet plant was commissioned in May 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The Surya copper plant was successfully commissioned in 6 months.
capex_expansion.quote: Copper, which is a new gold and Congo, which is our new Surjagarh is led by Surya. I want to congratulate his team and him for successful commissioning of the Surya copper plant in 6 months.

capex_expansion.claim: The company incurred capex of INR 1,35,130 million during FY24-FY26 and 81,310 million in FY26 alone.
capex_expansion.quote: The company has incurred capex of INR 1,35,130 mn during FY24-FY26 and 81,310 Mn in FY26 alone.

capex_expansion.claim: The 2nd Pellet Plant was commissioned in May 2026.
LMEL commenced commercial production of copper cathodes from its 12,000 TPA plant in Surya Mines in the DRC in March 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: LMEL has commenced commercial production of copper cathodes from its 12,000 TPA plant in Surya Mines in the DRC in March 2026, marking operational readiness and formal entry into the global copper value chain.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin held steady at approximately 34% across the last 2 quarters.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin has held steady at approximately 34% across both the last 2 quarters, demonstrating structural cost efficiency and not one-off gains.

margins_costs.claim: Annual cost savings are expected to surpass INR2,000 crores per annum as logistics and sustainability initiatives mature.
margins_costs.quote: We expect annual cost savings to surpass INR2,000 crores per annum as all logistics and sustainability initiatives are maturing by March '28.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone EBITDA margin for FY26 stood at 33.77%, up 418 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin for the full year stood at 33.77%, up 418 basis points year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins expanded to 33.73 percent in Q4FY26 and 33.77 percent in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins expanded to 33.73% in Q4FY26 (+1,058 bps YoY) and 33.77% in FY26 (+418 bps YoY), reflecting strong operating leverage

margins_costs.claim: A richer product mix with higher contribution from value-added products led to meaningful margin expansion.
margins_costs.quote: A richer product mix, with higher contribution from value-added products like pellets, led to meaningful margin expansion.

margins_costs.claim: Sustainability initiatives are also driving structural cost optimisation.
margins_costs.quote: Sustainability initiatives also driving structural cost optimisation.

orders_capacity.claim: Iron ore production scaled from 10 million to 22 million tons, representing a 120% growth in a single year.
orders_capacity.quote: On operations, our iron ore scaled from 10 million to 22 million tons, which is a 120% growth in a single year.

orders_capacity.claim: The pellet plant commissioned at the end of Q2 reached 100% capacity utilization within 4 months.
orders_capacity.quote: The pellet plant commissioned at the fag end of Q2 reached 100% capacity utilization within just 4 months, 3 million tons in 9 months, a ramp-up that very few plants anywhere in the country have achieved.
DRI volume scaled 56% year-on-year with the new kiln ramping up steadily as the pellet plant.

orders_capacity.claim: Environment capacity at Gadchiroli operations has been increased from 10 MTPA to 55 MTPA.
orders_capacity.quote: Environment Capacity has been increased from 10 MTPA to 55MTPA
